Five merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a `hasPrivilege` line under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs`. I checked the default branch (`master`) up to its head at `5eb8cba`. Each date is the commit date of the squash-merge commit.

Best-supported first:

1. **#6668** (TRUNK-6802, "Extend hasPermission to support custom rules"), merged 2026-10-13. Removes `if (Context.hasPrivilege(privilege)) {` from `OpenmrsPermissionEvaluator.java`, replaced by `FilterPassPrivilegeCache.holdsPrivilege(...)`. Commit `cb6cda4236b21a84cc4e1765a0dbaa58fdbe2565`.
2. **#6598** (TRUNK-6707, "Implement full caching for Global Properties"), merged 2026-10-01. Adds `Context.hasPrivilege(gp.getViewPrivilege(), false)` in `AdministrationServiceImpl.checkCanView`. Commit `07e8ea06f244de96907581535d4eff8dadbd0004`.
3. **#6383** (TRUNK-6712, "Cache flattened role privileges"), merged 2026-07-24. Rewrites `UserContext.hasPrivilege` and adds `hasPrivilege(String, boolean)`, plus a new `Context.hasPrivilege(String, boolean)`. Commit `1b5421a9a8d69030adb91124c3f9cb758dbc58a8`.
4. **#6186** ("Require Get Alerts privilege to read all users' alerts"), merged 2026-06-18. Adds `return Context.hasPrivilege(PrivilegeConstants.GET_ALERTS);` in `AlertServiceImpl.canViewAllAlerts`. Commit `f5c03501860de4372d7e0e12f9c3dbe025a38dc8`.
5. **#6544** (TRUNK-6799, "Introduce Spring Security"), merged 2026-10-08. Adds the new `org/openmrs/security` classes, which contain `hasPrivilege` lines (for example `PrivilegeResolution.java:30`). This is inferred rather than diffed: a grep at the parent commit `49c3273` found no `hasPrivilege` under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security`, and the current tree has several. Commit `a69b14a84bf925ff7cdf34e93ca1ffb4f257265f`.

Checked and excluded: #6674 (`5eb8cba`), #6671 (`7b9487c`), #6627 (`2c9b2ee`), #6508 (`a48d5d8`), #6483 (`4d92b49`), #6654 (`83411b2`), #6672 (`0340ada`). Their diffs for the files I inspected have no `hasPrivilege` lines. Commit `3310bc1` has no PR number, so I left it out.

Limits of this check:
- The full diffs for `1b5421a` and `5eb8cba` were too large to read; I checked only the files listed above, so other files in those commits could still contain `hasPrivilege` lines.
- I did not diff the other PRs in the window, for example #6317, #6318, #6324 and #6315. Their messages describe `@Authorized` or merge changes, not `hasPrivilege`.

- `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/UserContext.java` lines 494–527
- `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/Context.java` lines 783–789
